verdict.rationale: Sift documents Review Queues alongside its Workflows platform, and its Decisions API records the business actions taken on users, such as approving an order or banning an account. That gives a basic review-and-decision record, and the founder confirms most customers have humans make final go/no-go calls on flagged users. However, the evidence never covers team collaboration features or a reviewer-attributed audit trail with reasons. Missing for 10: reviewer assignment, escalation paths, SLA tracking/timers, an audit trail showing who approved what and why, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of Review Queue team workflows.
